Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- The anniversary overwrite retires the base clause "the anniversary bonus of anniversary_bonus_points is credited on each anniversary…", while the extended baseline re-enacts the same amount ("the anniversary tier amount, which is the anniversary_bonus_points of the tier held on the credit date"). The KB renders both faithfully (retired clause in `…bonus_and_referral_terms_d0fb29da`, baseline in `…anniversary_bonus_amount_ed53eb82`), and the retired sentence points to "the current bases"; a reader is not misled, but the tension originates in the source's choice of superseded clause.
- The gift card extended policy's baseline rule bundles the availability condition (nothing pending, one entry carrying the brand) with the valuation; the KB carries the availability half in the hub and the valuation half in the computation document. No atom is lost.
